Description

Observation of sea ice in the Arctic waters. Monitoring of the Northern sea routes and the CO2 content of the atmosphere.
World's first commercial microsatellite owned by a private company. 
Notes

The mass turned out to be 10.1 kg and should be removed but making an exception because of the long time.
